errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.invalid_input: Some fields are missing or invalid.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired or you don’t have Shop in this workspace.
errors.forbidden: Only workspace admins can do this.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
errors.invalid_handle: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens.
errors.invalid_currency: Pick a currency from the list.
errors.invalid_locale: Pick a language from the list.
errors.invalid_theme: Pick a theme from the list.
errors.image_type: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or AVIF image.
errors.storage_unavailable: File storage isn’t configured on this server.
errors.options_required: Add an option (like Size) to have more than one variant.
errors.variant_options: Each variant needs a value for every option.
errors.duplicate_variant: Two variants have the same options.
errors.too_many_locations: You can have up to 50 locations.
errors.default_location: The default location can’t be removed.
errors.location_has_stock: Move or zero its stock before removing this location.
errors.below_reserved: Stock can’t go below what pending orders reserved.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
errors.invalid_weight_range: The minimum weight is above the maximum.
errors.duplicate_tax_rate: Two tax rates have the same country and region.
errors.csv_format: That CSV isn’t a Shopify or Tiendanube product export.
errors.invalid_status: The order isn’t in a state that allows this.
errors.invalid_tracking_url: The tracking link must start with http:// or https://.
errors.refund_unavailable: This payment can’t be refunded from here. Refund it in the provider’s dashboard.
errors.stripe_invalid_webhook_secret: The webhook signing secret starts with whsec_.
errors.mp_invalid_token: Mercado Pago rejected that access token.
errors.mp_error: Mercado Pago didn’t respond. Try again.
errors.mp_invalid_webhook_secret: Paste the secret signature from Mercado Pago’s webhooks page.
errors.payment_unavailable: That payment method isn’t set up.
errors.link_unavailable: You need the Link app to create short links.
errors.invalid_slug: That short link alias isn’t valid.
errors.quota_exceeded: You reached the link limit of your plan.
errors.unsafe_url: That address can’t be reached from here.
errors.self_link: That URL is already a short link.

products.desc: Your catalog: variants, prices, stock and photos.
products.search: Search by name, SKU, barcode or tag
products.emptyBody: Add a product with its options, prices and stock. It shows in your store when it’s active.
products.importHint: or import a Shopify or Tiendanube CSV
products.caption: Products ({n})
products.importHelp: Upload the product CSV exported from Shopify (Products › Export) or Tiendanube (Products › Export). Photos are downloaded from their URLs and stock goes to your default location.
products.importUpdate: Update products that already exist (same handle)
products.importImagesPending: {n} products are still missing their photos. Import the same file again with “Update products that already exist” to download the rest.

editor.title: Title
editor.descriptionHelp: A blank line starts a new paragraph. Bold, italics and links (HTML) are kept; everything else is removed.
editor.optionsHelp: Like Size or Color, with values separated by commas. Each combination becomes a variant.
editor.weightHelp: Prices in {currency}. Weight in grams is used by weight-based shipping rates.
editor.storeUnpublished: Your store isn’t published yet: nobody sees it.
editor.deleteBody: The product leaves your store and its stock is removed. Past orders keep their items.
editor.shareHelp: Creates a Link short link to this product with the UTM tags you choose, so you can see clicks and sales by campaign.

inventory.desc: Stock per variant and location. Low stock is {n} units or less.
inventory.search: Filter by product, variant or SKU
inventory.emptyBody: Products that track stock show up here.
inventory.noLow: No product is low on stock.
inventory.reservedAt: {n} units are held by pending orders at {location}.

collections.desc: Group products for your store’s menu and home page.
collections.emptyBody: Pick products by hand or let rules fill the collection (for example, every product tagged summer).
collections.deleteBody: The products stay; only the collection is removed.

orders.desc: Every order from your store, with payment and shipping status.
orders.search: Search by number, email or name
orders.emptyBody: Orders from your store show up here.
orders.caption: Orders ({n})

order.title: Order #{n}
order.markPaidBody: Do this when the transfer reached your account. Stock is taken out and the customer gets the confirmation email.
order.notifyCustomer: Email the customer that the order shipped
order.expired: Cancelled because the payment didn’t arrive in time.
order.restock: Put the items back in stock
order.refundHelp: The refund goes through the same provider the customer paid with.
order.refundManualHelp: Transfers are refunded outside zerosoft; this records it on the order.
order.cancelBody: The reserved stock is released and the discount code use is given back.
order.cancelPaidBody: The items go back to stock.
order.notePh: Internal note (the customer doesn’t see it)
order.paidAfterCancel: This order is cancelled, but {amount} it was paid hasn’t been refunded. Refund it to the customer.
order.restockFullOnly: Restock only applies to a full refund

customers.desc: People who bought from your store. Each one is also a CRM contact.
customers.emptyBody: Customers are created with their first order. Checkout works as a guest; no account needed.
customers.crmPending: Linked to the CRM with the first paid order.

discounts.desc: Codes for a percentage, a fixed amount or free shipping.
discounts.emptyBody: Create a code like WELCOME10 with a minimum order, a usage limit or an end date.
discounts.codeHelp: Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores. Customers type it at checkout.
discounts.limitHelp: Leave it empty for unlimited uses.
discounts.deleteBody: Customers can’t use it anymore. Orders that used it keep their discount.

analytics.desc: Paid sales, orders and how many visits turn into orders.
analytics.chartLabel: Sales per day for the last {days} days
analytics.empty: No paid orders in this range.
analytics.funnelHelp: Visits count page views of your store. Conversion is paid orders divided by visits.

settings.desc: Your store, its look, payments, shipping and taxes.
settings.adminOnly: Only workspace admins see and change payment settings.
settings.name: Store name
settings.contactEmailHelp: Shown in the store footer and used as the reply-to of order emails.
settings.publishedHelp: While it’s off, the store and its products give a not-found page.
settings.customDomain: Custom domains aren’t available for stores yet: your store lives on the zerosoft address.

themeHelp.classic: Clean, with a white header and your color on the buttons.
themeHelp.bold: Header in your brand color and big uppercase titles.
themeHelp.minimal: Lots of white space and a centered home page.

settings.stripeHelp: Card payments with Stripe Checkout. Paste a secret or restricted key from your Stripe dashboard.
settings.stripeWebhookHelp: In Stripe › Developers › Webhooks, add this endpoint with the checkout.session.completed and checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded events, then paste its signing secret above.
settings.mpHelp: Mercado Pago Checkout Pro (cards, cash and wallet). Paste the production access token of your application.
settings.mpWebhookHelp: In Mercado Pago › Your integrations › Webhooks, add this URL with the Payments event, then paste the secret signature above.
settings.manualEnable: Offer bank transfer at checkout (the order waits until you mark it as paid)
settings.manualInstructionsPh: Bank, account holder, account number or CBU/CVU, and where to send the receipt.
settings.paymentsDocs: Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again. The docs explain each step: zerosoft.ai/docs (Shop › Payments).
settings.shippingHelp: A rate applies to the countries listed (empty means every country). Weight rates apply when the cart weight is in the range. Free from an amount: the rate costs zero when the order reaches it.
settings.noRates: No rates yet: products that need shipping can’t be bought.
settings.countriesHelp: Two-letter codes separated by commas. Empty: every country.
settings.taxIncluded: My prices already include taxes (common with VAT)
settings.taxHelp: One rate per country, and per region if it changes. The region rate wins over the country rate.
settings.emailConfirmation: Email the order confirmation to the customer
settings.emailShipped: Email the customer when the order ships
settings.crmSync: Create or update the customer in the CRM and log the order there
settings.holdMinutes: Minutes an online order holds stock while waiting for payment
settings.holdHelp: After that, the unpaid order is cancelled and the stock goes back on sale.
settings.emailFrom: Emails go out from zerosoft’s address with your store name, and replies go to your contact email.
settings.adminOnlyStore: Only workspace admins change the store address, the currency and whether it is published.

storefront.itemsRemoved: Some items are no longer for sale and were left out.
storefront.shippingAtCheckout: Shipping and taxes are calculated at checkout.
storefront.guestNote: No account needed. We’ll send the order updates to this email.
storefront.chooseCountryFirst: Choose a country to see the shipping options.
storefront.orderLookupHelp: Enter the order number and the email you used to buy.
storefront.transferRef: Include order #{n} in the transfer description.

errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.out_of_stock: An item ran out while you were checking out. Review your cart.
errors.cart_changed: Some items are no longer for sale. Review your cart.
errors.no_shipping_rate: We don’t ship to that country yet.
errors.payment_unavailable: This store can’t take payments right now.
errors.store_closed: This store isn’t taking orders right now.
errors.discount_used_up: That code reached its usage limit.
errors.discount_min_order: Your order doesn’t reach the minimum for that code.
errors.stripe_error: The payment provider didn’t respond. Try again.
errors.mp_error: The payment provider didn’t respond. Try again.
